observations.why: The directive enacts authority-ranking by imposing a mandatory gate condition on all Meridian deployments — a rank-based command, not a proposal.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifies the gate by proportionality — past cost (unsigned artifacts reaching staging) is the stated basis for the consequence, a cost/benefit framing.
The Gate declaration re-enacts the authority-ranking command in compressed imperative form — a binding requirement issued by the position-holder.
Extends the gate's authority across environments — the position-holder defines the scope of what the command governs, an authority-ranking move.
Self-assignment of the Owner role enacts authority-ranking — the speaker claims positional responsibility and rank over the gate.
